content.thinking: "commit chain" fails: the ACK frame is in an A-level packet, but I set `sent={"I":[[0,0]],...}` — the ACK in an A packet checks sent.A which is empty → PROTOCOL_VIOLATION. My test config was wrong (I set sent.I instead of sent.A). Let me fix: sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[[0,0]]}.

arguments.command:
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 - <<'EOF'
src = open("test_undo.py").read()
src = src.replace('ok &= check("commit chain", CFG(sent={"I":[[0,0]],"H":[],"A":[]}), [',
                  'ok &= check("commit chain", CFG(sent={"I":[],"H":[],"A":[[0,0]]}), [')
open("test_undo.py","w").write(src)
EOF
cd /app/tmp/t && python3 test_undo.py 2>&1 | grep -E "^FAIL|ALL PASS|SOME FAILED" -A2
